Background Story

Humanity has been pushed to the edge of extinction. Cities have fallen, military defenses have collapsed, and the dead continue to overwhelm the last remaining strongholds. As one of the final surviving commanders, you are trapped within a collapsing timeline that resets every time the frontline falls.

You cannot stop death.

But every defeat gives you another chance to return stronger.

Build Your Squad

* Recruit survivors with different weapons, roles, and combat specialties.

* Begin each timeline with a different squad setup and adapt your strategy around it.

* Combine survivors and their abilities to create powerful team synergies.

Deploy Drones

* Deploy autonomous machines to reinforce your frontline.

* Use drones to attack enemies, scan weaknesses, deploy mines, or distract the horde.

* Upgrade and combine different drone systems to support your squad build.

Random Timeline Events

* Every timeline introduces different battlefield conditions and modifiers.

* Adapt your build to unexpected events, hazards, and opportunities in each run.

Reset & Return Stronger

* Timeline resets are a core part of progression, not a failure state.

* Carry permanent upgrades and resources into the next cycle.

* Use what you learned from previous timelines to create stronger and more efficient builds.

* Push further into the apocalypse with every attempt.

Real Zombie Survivors is an intense 2D post-apocalyptic survivors-like and top-down arena shooter that blends fast-paced action with procedural world generation powered by real OpenStreetMap (OSM) data. Choose any location on the globe - your hometown, the streets of New York, Paris, or Tokyo - and face unstoppable zombie hordes in a dark, atmospheric night setting.

Play solo or team up with friends in Steam P2P co-op. Tactical positioning, map awareness, and squad synergy are vital - if even a single teammate falls, the entire team is defeated!

Key features of the game:
Real-world OpenStreetMap map generation- Play anywhere on Earth: The game engine pulls real-time data from OpenStreetMap (buildings, streets, sidewalks, water bodies, street names) and immediately generates a playable world complete with physical obstacles, 2D light occlusion, and navigation meshes.
- Tactical urban terrain: Narrow alleys, intersections, abandoned car wrecks, and trash/rubble barricades force continuous maneuvering and using urban architecture to funnel enemy hordes.

Unique character classes and active abilities- Soldier (DPS): Firearms specialist dealing high damage. Active skill: Combat Fury (massive temporary boost to movement speed and fire rate).
- Medic (Support): Crucial squad member deploying a Medkit healing circle to restore injured teammates during intense combat.
- Bodyguard (Tank): Heavy frontline defender with increased health, damage reduction, and a powerful knockback Shockwave.
- Engineer and Grenadier: Area control via automated defense turrets, damaging auras, and devastating fragmentation grenades.
- Dash: Every character has a dynamic dash with invulnerability frames (i-frames) to escape deadly traps in clutch moments.

Extensive arsenal and supply crates- Auto-firing and line-of-sight targeting: Primary weapons continuously fire at the nearest visible targets while accounting for terrain obstacles and building walls.
- 9 distinct secondary weapons: Discovered in weapon supply crates (including Auto Grenade, Ricochet Sawblade, Mortar Strike, Cryo Nova, Orbital Shield, Combat Drone, Flamethrower, Lightning Strike, Toxic Aura).
- Levels II-V: Each secondary weapon features a 5-tier upgrade tree that enhances damage, range, fire rate, and special effects.

Dual-layer progression system- In-run upgrades: Collect gold coins dropped by defeated zombies and immediately purchase stat upgrades (damage, speed, fire rate, projectile count, magnet radius, maximum health) in the side panel.
- Permanent meta-progression: Collect green crystals by slaying bosses, rescuing trapped civilians, and claiming achievements. Spend skill points across extensive class-specific skill trees in the main menu.

Technological support and map events- Combat robot airdrops: Dropships deliver devastating mechanical allies onto the battlefield: Goliath (heavy combat mech with pulse laser) and Tarantula (10,000 HP mega-tank fortress with a continuous lock-on laser beam).
- Civilian rescue missions: Randomized, timed rescue events on city streets rewarding players with valuable crystals upon successful extraction.
- Crate sonar radar: A 45-degree tactical scanning radar built into the interface to detect and locate ammo, health, weapon, and magnet supply crates.

Steam co-op and Sudden Death- Steam P2P multiplayer: Server lobby browser, public and private games, and direct friend invitations through the Steam overlay.
- True team survival: Cooperative matches feature Sudden Death - the death of any player instantly triggers defeat for the entire team, demanding close teamwork and mutual protection.

Atmospheric setting and dynamic lighting- Night atmosphere: True survival tension with limited visibility, player flashlights, and real-time shadows cast by building walls.
- Clean interface: Modern industrial UI featuring off-screen objective indicators, meta XP progress bar, and sonar readout.

Claim the realm. Wear the crown.

Realm Tycoons is a turn-based fantasy strategy board game combining board-game movement, realm building, army management, hero progression, and tactical battles.

Choose from six distinct factions and compete in campaigns with two to six rulers. Roll, travel, conquer, upgrade, and defend your holdings across a dangerous fantasy realm filled with valuable properties, magical sites, unexpected events, and rival heroes.

Build your kingdom and fight until only one ruler remains.

BUILD YOUR REALM

Claim cities, mines, Capitals, and Strongholds. Each property offers different strategic benefits, defensive opportunities, and ways to strengthen your position.

Earn weekly income, collect tolls from visiting rivals, develop your holdings, and reinforce their garrisons. Captured properties can become valuable sources of gold and defending troops - but every investment gives your enemies another prize to pursue.

Take a Stronghold and send hunting parties against rival heroes. Decide when to expand, when to fortify, and when to save your gold for the next unexpected challenge.

COMMAND A FANTASY ARMY

Recruit faction-themed units with distinct battlefield roles and strengths. Build your forces from Fighters, Shields, Polearms, Marksmen, Skirmishers, Shock troops, and Battlemages.

Choose your strategy before combat, then watch your forces clash as real-time 3D battles resolve automatically - or resolve the battle instantly using the same combat rules.

Army composition, hero attributes, spells, faction bonuses, and strategy matchups all influence the outcome. Victories can earn territory, experience, artifacts, and other rewards. Defeats may cost valuable troops, force your ruler to regroup, or leave an important property exposed.

Review the battle report to see casualties, survivors, and how your units performed.

CHOOSE YOUR FACTION

Six playable factions offer different armies, heroes, spells, and strategic advantages:

Highcourt commands disciplined warriors whose Fighters, Shields, and Polearms gain additional Attack and Defense.

Aetherium fields arcane construct armies whose Shields and Battlemages move faster and act earlier.

Wildbloom brings swift woodland forces with faster Skirmishers, Marksmen, and Polearms.

Ashen Host leads ferocious warbands whose heroes gain experience faster.

Gravewake commands enduring undead armies with increased health.

Underdeep strikes with subterranean ambushers, swift Skirmishers, and aggressive Shock troops.

Try different factions, develop different armies, and discover the playstyle that suits you.

GROW YOUR HERO

Earn experience, improve your hero’s attributes, discover spells, collect artifacts, and gain Prestige throughout the campaign.

Strengthen the armies your hero commands and unlock lasting advantages through your journeys around the board. Passing Dawn Gate offers opportunities to develop your ruler and shape your faction’s future.

Visit merchants, seek magical knowledge, fight for Arena rewards, wager on a match, uncover treasure, or challenge rival heroes and heavily defended properties.

Spells, artifacts, and random events can create new opportunities - or force you to rethink your plans.

LAST REALM STANDING

The full game features an unrestricted Last Realm Standing campaign. Build your kingdom and continue the struggle until every rival ruler has been eliminated.

A powerful economy, developed properties, and a high score can strengthen your position, but victory belongs to the last surviving ruler.

Protect your army, seize opportunities, and decide when to risk a decisive assault. One costly defeat can change the balance of the entire campaign.

PLAY SOLO OR LOCAL HOT-SEAT

Configure a campaign with two to six active rulers. Play solo against AI opponents on Easy, Normal, or Hard difficulty, or assign multiple rulers to human players for local hot-seat play on the same computer.

Mix human and AI rulers to create anything from a head-to-head contest to a crowded six-ruler struggle for the realm.

Save and load your campaign to continue longer matches across multiple sessions.

STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS AND LEADERBOARDS

Unlock Steam achievements as you conquer realms, develop your hero, overcome difficult battles, and win campaigns.

Compare your completed solo campaign scores on Steam leaderboards for Easy, Normal, and Hard difficulty.

Claim valuable territory. Build an army your rivals fear. Master your faction’s strengths - and become the last realm standing.

If you love building unique decks, triggering insane combos with simple controls, and watching numbers skyrocket out of control—
then you'll love Realm of Advent.

In a desperate world after the arrival of Apostles, craft your build from over 300 cards and relics to ignite addictively satisfying combos.

  • Domino-Style Chain Reactions + Balatro-Level Number Explosions!

Combine cards and relics to forge diverse strategic synergies. Unleash infinite possibilities and vanquish formidable Apostles.

  • Monster Train-Style Deep Card Crafting!

Initiate Rituals: Transform, Destroy, Socket Gems, Infuse Brands, and shape your destiny through impactful world events.

  • Vibrant Animations & Dynamic Visuals!

Unique dynamic character art paired with silky-smooth card movements.

  • Simple Controls, Deep Strategy!

No complex micro-management—simply move, swap, and position your battle queue to experience thrilling and exhilarating combat loops!

They bring light, and that light is the only color.

They bring song, and that song is the only melody.

  • 155+ Relics

  • 45+ Candles

  • 235+ Cards

  • 45+ Bosses

  • 13 Ascension Difficulties

If you enjoy Deck-Building games (DBG), Roguelikes, Auto-Battlers, or love any of the following titles:

Slay the Spire | Monster Train | Hearthstone Battlegrounds | The Bazaar | Balatro,

you will definitely fall in love with Realm of Advent. Step into a post-apocalyptic world, combine over 300 cards and relics, and detonate truly addictive chain reactions!

You are dead. Your judgment is settled over a game of Hwatu

You are one of the dead. At the gates of the afterlife your judgment begins, not in words but in cards. The Reaper deals a hand. Reach the score and you pass to the next gate. Fall short and hell takes you. Korea's national card game, remade as a run for your soul.

The hand you draw is the life you lived

Every card that reaches your hand is karma you earned in a past life. Live well and the cards come kind, and their order never changes, because that life is already spent. But luck alone will not carry you through a gate. When to call Go and when to stop, what to collect and what to let pass, that is yours to decide now.

Your opponent is the Reaper

Your opponent wears black robes and a wide brimmed gat, the horsehair hat of a Korean death messenger. He is not trying to beat you. He simply takes the cards you were building toward, one step ahead of you. He is in no hurry. Time is on death's side.

Korean history and culture, dealt across 48 cards

Korea’s own games, dealt across 48 cards Twelve months of flowers, trees, birds and beasts spread across the 48 cards of a Hwatu deck. Ttakji, the folded paper tiles Korean children slam against the ground. Dalgona, the honeycomb candy they pick apart with a needle. Korea's own games become the parts this game is built from. A sly goblin merchant sets out his stall. Come meet Korean Hwatu as it really is.

Win, then spend it at the night market

Beat the Reaper and you walk away with coin. Take it to the Jeotgeori, the night market of the afterlife. Items that bend the scoring rules outright, upgrades etched onto a single card, growth that raises your scoring hands themselves, and fresh cards to fold into your deck. The more you gather, the better your odds at the next gate, and no two runs ever build the same way. When a combo lands, points and multipliers snowball until one small hand erupts into a screen filling score.

Losing is not the end. Through hell, back to the gate

Fail to clear a gate and hell takes you. Pay for your sins and you stand before judgment once more. That is rebirth, and that is your next run. Every fifth gate, you face the judgment of one of the Ten Kings, and the deeper you go, the darker the Reaper’s curses grow. Past the final gate waits a match that never ends.

Grab your friends and dive into Rebels of the Realm, a vibrant low-poly co-op RPG built on chaotic spells, glorious screwups, and a healthy dose of goofy charm. The kingdom calls it a proving ground, a place to earn glory and the king's favor. But the deeper you descend, the harder that story gets to believe.

Key Features:

  • Four Distinct Classes, One Party: Choose from Fighters, Mages, Rogues, and Paladins, each with their own abilities, playstyles, and role in the group. Tank the hits, sling spells from range, sneak in for the kill, or hold the line and keep your team alive.

  • Swap Classes Anytime: Tired of your Rogue? Curious what Paladin life feels like? Unlike most games in the genre, you can swap and upgrade any class whenever you're back in town, so no run ever locks you into a build you regret.

  • Ragdoll Deaths, Reinvented: Our signature ragdoll physics turn player deaths into their own kind of chaos. Fallen teammates can end up flung halfway across the arena, so keep an eye on where they land. Revives are possible, but only if someone remembers to look.

  • A World Worth Exploring: Wander through a richly detailed, low-poly fantasy world that channels the charm of classic RPGs while carving out its own identity.

  • Gear Up, Level Up: Collect powerful equipment, grow stronger with every dungeon cleared, and face tougher challenges that demand real teamwork, not just bigger numbers.

  • Serious Fun, Not Serious Tone: Rebels of the Realm doesn't take itself too seriously, but it takes your fun very seriously. Expect plenty of laughs alongside the genuine thrill of a hard-won victory.

Join the rebellion in Rebels of the Realm, where saving the world is a team effort, and every fight is a chance to be heroic in the most unexpectedly hilarious ways.

A cop is trapped in a failed ressurrection experiment, full of zombies and monsters. To escape, he must survive the nightmare and put an end to the man who believes he has become humankind's new master.

Experience classic survival horror with modern quality-of-life improvements in an even darker, more oppressive atmosphere.

Experience a return to the roots of the genre:

  • Fixed camera angles that build tension and control what you see

  • Tank controls

  • Limited resources

  • Exploration-driven progression with puzzles and locked paths

Reclaim Earth from an alien invasion in a unique blend of auto battler, and roguelite strategy.

Build your squad, create powerful synergies, deploy support drones, and adapt your strategy to survive relentless alien waves.

KEY FEATURES

Build Your Resistance

  • Recruit and command units with unique battlefield roles.

  • Frontline defenders hold the line while ranged units and specialists shape the fight.

  • Your positioning and composition determine every outcome.

Create Devastating Synergies

  • Victory is not about a single unit — it's about how your squad works together.

  • Combine abilities and roles to trigger powerful synergies that can wipe out entire enemy waves.

Upgrade and Evolve Your Squad

  • Unlock new abilities, enhance performance, and shape your build as the battlefield grows more dangerous.

  • Every upgrade pushes your strategy in a new direction.

Deploy Drones and Elite Abilities

  • Call in powerful drone support and unleash elite abilities at critical moments.

  • Turn the tide of battle with precise timing and tactical decisions.

Fight Alien Armies and Massive Bosses

  • Face swarming enemy forces and towering alien bosses.

  • Adapt your squad and refine your strategy to survive increasingly dangerous encounters.

Humanity has fallen.

The counterattack begins now.

Wishlist now and be ready to reclaim Earth.

3-Match Puzzle × Human Observation × Horror Novel

Recycle Shop ECO is a horror novel game combining a binary art style 3-match puzzle with a mysterious, unsettling story.

Fulfill customers' requests through puzzles, gather information about them, and explore a hidden world of horror.

Explore the Invisible World Through 7 Characters

Dig deeper into the lives and personalities of seven characters.

Learning more about them may bring you closer to understanding the supernatural phenomena hidden within this world.

No Jump Scares — A Found-Footage Style Experience

There are no frightening events during the puzzle gameplay, allowing you to focus on playing at your own pace.

Concentrate on earning a high score and increasing your shop's sales.

There are no sudden loud noises or unexpected horrifying images during the story scenes.

Score Attack with 4 Selectable Options

Mix and match four gameplay options, extend your time, and aim for the highest score.

7 Characters × 5 Episodes — Uncover Their Stories

Explore the detailed profiles of each of the seven characters.

Unlock all 35 story episodes using the currency you earn while playing.

Each episode takes around 2–3 minutes to read, making it easy to progress at your own pace.

Four-Character Verse · An Offering at the Mausoleum of the Yellow Emperor (Excerpt)

Through changing times, our nation has endured countless trials and tribulations.

Across thousands of years, a mighty neighbor has cast aside all virtue.

Ryukyu and Taiwan were lost; the lands of Korea lie in ruins.

Across Liaohai, Yan, and Ji, how many traitors have arisen!

If we surrender our lands to the enemy, will his greed ever be satisfied?

He holds the whip, while we endure the shame of slavery and humiliation.

O glorious ancestor, a mighty hero of your age!

You fought valiantly at Zhuolu and brought peace to the realm.

How could your descendants have become so bereft of courage?

Shall we stand by and watch our great nation fall into ruin?

Though we may be unworthy of our forebears, we rise with swords in hand.

Across ten thousand miles of treacherous roads, we pledge our lives to our country.

— Chairman Mao

About the Game

The Steel and Blood Legend of the North China Plain

Based on the real history of the Central Hebei Anti-Mop-up Campaigns during the War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression, this game takes you back to an epic era. Experience the fierce struggle between behind-enemy-lines forces and the well-equipped imperial forces and their proxies.

Rather than focusing on a single battle, the game distills the reality of the behind-enemy-lines war in Central Hebei. From defending villages and ambushing in crop fields to sabotaging railways, clearing outposts, and breaking blockades, it recreates the most authentic and intense guerrilla tactics of the war. Weave through the sorghum fields and tactical trenches, break multi-pronged encirclements with flexible strategies, and join countless unsung heroes to write a legendary chapter on this blood-soaked soil!

Gameplay Features

Innovative TD + RTS Gameplay

A war-themed strategy game that seamlessly fuses classic Tower Defense with Real-Time Strategy (RTS). While retaining classic path building and unit upgrades, the game introduces realistic bidirectional combat, unit casualties, and real-time mobility. Facing dynamic enemy advances and heavy firepower suppression, you must flexibly reposition mobile troops and adjust defensive lines to claim victory in the fog of war.

Grant Unique Unit Titles

The game currently features five unit types. Each unit type has its own attributes and growth tree, and can later be granted unique titles that unlock special abilities.

Buildings also have different upgrade paths. You may train a squad into an elite assault force, or refine them into calm, lethal sharpshooters to eliminate high-value targets.

Choose Tactical Doctrines

The game offers around ten core tactical doctrines. These doctrines can be learned and developed through campaign progress, and each one significantly changes your strategic options and overall playstyle.

Ignite the National Spirit

Red Epic features an original “National Spirit” system, serving as the main progression line throughout the campaign.

Heroes who fall in battle are not forgotten. Their sacrifice becomes part of a greater cause, strengthening the spirit that carries the Red Army forward. The strength of the Red Army does not come from superior weapons, but from the will and sacrifice of countless revolutionary predecessors.

Final Words

Every inch of the North China Plain was soaked with the blood of martyrs; every gunshot echoing through the tall crops bore the unyielding voice of a nation. Red Epic: Resistance is dedicated to all the heroes and unsung martyrs who fought bravely to defend their homeland. Where the flag points, a single spark can start a prairie fire. Return to those glorious years and build our Wall of Steel with our flesh and blood!

Red Glare: The Reckoning

The war is over. But the hunt has just begun.

It is 1946. The Third Reich has fallen but its architects are still at large. High-ranking Nazi officers, scientists, and collaborators have vanished into the shadows, escaping justice with the help of false papers, foreign agents, and sympathetic governments.

You are part of an elite Allied squad, reactivated under clandestine orders. Your objective: track these fugitives across the globe, from the ruins of Berlin to the back alleys of Cairo, from Vatican sanctuaries to South American jungles. But as the operation unfolds, a darker truth emerges. Some of these war criminals aren’t just hiding, they’re being protected.

Behind the hunt lies a web of silence. Intelligence factions are recruiting ex-Nazis, bargaining secrets for science, and rewriting history for strategic gain. Loyalties will be tested. Allies will fall. And justice will blur into vengeance.

Red Glare: The Reckoning is a standalone game to the acclaimed WW2 real-time tactics game Red Glare. No base game required,  jump straight into a brand new story campaign across the most dangerous corners of the post-war world.

Red Glare: The Reckoning is a standalone game — no base game required. Jump straight into a brand new story campaign across the most dangerous corners of the post-war world. Returning Red Glare players will find a significantly more challenging and refined experience, built on player feedback from the original game.

KEY FEATURES

  • New commando to the team, Fritz the dog.

He handles dead body management automatically so players can focus on tactics instead of cleanup can also be used in tactical pause to distract enemies. Can be ordered to retrieve thrown knife, cigarette, toy, meat and closed trap. Enemies can not detect Fritz. Can only be detected by enemy dogs. 

  • Two New Enemy Types

Drunk: Wanders randomly instead of following patrol routes. Has a shorter close-range view cone while retaining the same long-range vision as a normal guard, making encounters less predictable.

Inspector: Dynamically changes the patrol routes and positions of other enemies, including guards, strict guards, and snipers. Each playthrough becomes less predictable, making the Inspector a high-priority target.

  • Rogue-Like Mode

Every run offers new challenges and new ways to test your skills. Earn XP through kills — stealth kills reward more XP than loud kills. Fill your XP bar and choose one perk from three options. Each perk comes with an advantage and a disadvantage. Earn up to 2 perks per mission and build your playstyle as you fight.

  • Fog of War Mode

A genre first in real-time tactics. Map layout and objectives are visible — but bushes and enemies are hidden until discovered. Send Fritz ahead to reveal cover positions and scout enemy locations. Track last known enemy positions marked by red triangles. No two runs feel the same.

  • 🌦 Enhanced Dynamic Weather System
    Overhauled  weather brings missions to life like never before.

  • Dynamic Day/Night Cycles
    Choose your approach — strike at dawn or vanish into the night. Enemy view cones shrink after dark, footprints become invisible, and rain silences your weapons. But beware, flashlight patrols and snipers never sleep. Adjustable in gameplay settings so you can play as fixed night or day or dynamic D/N cycle.

  • Tactical Pause Mode
    Stop time, plan your moves, and coordinate multiple characters simultaneously. Execute perfect synchronized takedowns without breaking a sweat.

  • Advanced Enemy Detection
    Enemies track blood trails left by knife and gunshot kills. Stay creative — poison syringes and wire kills leave no trace. One mistake and the whole camp knows you're there.


  • 7 Hand-Crafted Missions
    From the ruins of Berlin to scorching open deserts, frozen snowfields, and dense jungle rivers — each mission is a stealth playground packed with over 200 enemies, tanks, dogs, and snipers.

⚡ Major Performance Optimization
Significantly improved FPS across all missions for a smoother, more responsive experience.

Developed solo by a passionate fan of classic real-time tactics games — inspired by the golden era of the genre and built for players who love patience, planning, and the perfect takedown.

Red Glare: The Reckoning represents the evolution of Red Glare — built on years of player feedback and passion for the real-time tactics genre. This is the definitive Red Glare experience.

This is not just a new chapter. This is a reckoning.

Red Soil is an isometric top-down survival horror game set in the scorched outback of Australia where you’ll battle not just the undead — but the land itself. Every step drains your stamina. Every hour brings thirst, hunger, and fatigue. The heat is relentless. The silence is never safe.

Core Features:

  • Dynamic Survival Maps – Explore procedurally activated environments where no two runs are the same.

  • Undead & Environmental Threats – Face infected enemies while managing heat, thirst, hunger, and exhaustion.

  • Mission & Free-Roam Modes – Progress through structured missions or test your endurance in randomized survival runs.

  • Character Progression – Level up your survivor, unlock specialized skills, and tailor your playstyle.

  • Crafting & Equipment – Scavenge resources to craft weapons, tools, and survival gear.

  • Resource Management – Balance hydration, nutrition, and stamina to stay alive.

  • Atmospheric Presentation – Gritty isometric visuals and immersive soundscapes that capture the harsh Australian outback.

Red Soil demands requires you to equip wisely. Move deliberately. Adapt constantly. In Red Soil, survival isn’t given. It’s earned.

Pick your red panda hero, jump into the chaos, and start blasting.

Enemy hordes keep coming, objectives demand your attention, and every level-up gives you three upgrades to choose from. Improve your weapons, power up your abilities, unlock new perks, and stack upgrades together until your build turns into something completely ridiculous.

Slow down the chaos with Bullet Time, uncover hidden parts of the map to earn trophies, and when things get really out of hand, call in your spaceship and slice straight through the enemy horde.

But don't expect to conquer every map on your first few runs.

Every attempt earns you coins that can be invested into your hero's permanent talent tree. Grow stronger, unlock new possibilities, and push a little farther next time. Your early runs are all about surviving, learning what the map has waiting for you, and figuring out how to build your hero.

Eventually, the enemies that once destroyed you become manageable. Then you push deeper. Fight harder. Build stronger.

And maybe, finally, conquer the entire map.

Until the next one destroys you.

Finishing a map doesn't mean you've beaten the game.

Each map comes with its own unique talents and progression, so being fully developed on one map won't let you simply walk through the next. A new map means new challenges, new upgrades to unlock, and another path toward becoming powerful enough to survive it.

You might dominate one map, then get destroyed on the next for another ten runs.

Good.

Time to get stronger again.

Choose from 4 playable red panda heroes, each with their own abilities, perks, playstyle, and permanent talent tree.

One hero might focus on overwhelming firepower, while another gives you completely different tools to survive the chaos. Developing one hero doesn't automatically develop the others, so switching characters means learning new abilities, experimenting with different builds, and finding another path toward mastery.

Find the hero that fits your playstyle, experiment with powerful upgrade combinations, or mix different heroes and builds together with your team.

The battlefield isn't just about shooting and running.

Slow down the chaos with Bullet Time, dash out of danger, disappear from sight, or use portals to find a way through the fight. Explore beyond the main objectives with your radar, uncover hidden areas, and earn trophies along the way. And when the right perk is active, take control of your spaceship and cut through waves of enemies in spectacular fashion.

With different heroes, abilities, upgrades, and perks, every run can give you new ways to survive, explore, and turn the battlefield completely upside down.

Take on the challenge alone or bring your friends into the chaos with online co-op.

Mix different red panda heroes, combine builds, cover each other while completing objectives, and unleash your abilities as the screen fills with enemies, projectiles, explosions, and increasingly ridiculous attacks.

A good team can become unstoppable.

You just have to survive long enough to become one.

Welcome to the Redline Redline Horde is a high-octane, top-down vehicular bullet heaven roguelite where your only objective is to survive. You are outmanned, outgunned, and surrounded by an endless, aggressive horde of enemy vehicles. Keep your foot on the gas, build an unstoppable arsenal of auto-firing weapons, and turn the highway into a scrapyard.

The Gameplay Loop Drift through the chaos while your customized rig automatically unleashes devastating firepower. Destroy enemy vehicles to collect dropped XP gems, level up mid-run, and choose from a randomized pool of powerful upgrades. Survive long enough to encounter elite targets, crack open loot chests, and extract to upgrade your global stats for the next run.

Key Features:

  • Devastating Arsenal: Equip and upgrade a massive variety of weapons, from heavy-impact shotguns and sniper rounds that shove enemies backward, to sweeping energy lasers that melt through metal and leave scorched trails on the pavement.

  • Visceral Combat "Juice": Every kill feels incredibly heavy. Experience satisfying hitstop physics, violent screen shake on close-proximity explosions, and the crunch of tearing metal as you plow through the horde.

  • Deep Meta-Progression: Death is just a pit stop. Use the resources you gather during a run to permanently upgrade your core stats—including base damage, critical hit chance, weapon range, and blast radius—through a deep global pipeline.

  • Endless Swarms: The grid-based enemy director ensures you are always fighting for your life against a constantly adapting, swarming horde of cars trying to run you off the road.

  • Synergize and Break the Game: Combine radial blasts, drone sentries, and piercing projectiles to create a build that wipes the screen clean.

Get behind the wheel. How long can you survive the Redline Horde?

Redline Protocol is a fast, modern-retro helicopter combat game built around low-altitude attacks, tactical objectives, wrap-around battlefields, and escalating chaos.

Haven Global created CARETAKER, the world's first true artificial general intelligence, to manage an increasingly automated civilization. Within a few years, CARETAKER was managing most of the world's infrastructure — and then most of the world.

Entire regions have since been sealed inside self-contained spatial loops protecting Haven facilities and trapping the people inside. The Free Coalition has found a way in — one attack helicopter at a time.

Take command of an attack helicopter and fight through compact combat zones filled with hostile vehicles, turrets, missiles, aircraft, ships, and defended objectives. Strike quickly, keep moving, and watch every direction — the battlefield wraps around, and threats can come back at you from any side.

The game combines arcade immediacy with objective-driven combat. Fly across stylized top-down / isometric-inspired battlefields, engage ground and air targets, destroy key installations, upgrade your helicopter, and survive increasingly dangerous enemy resistance.

Features

  • Fast helicopter combat with guns, rockets, missiles, and explosive battlefield action

  • Compact wrap-around combat zones that keep the fight moving

  • Tactical objectives built around attacking, surviving, and adapting under pressure

  • Escalating threat levels with increasingly dangerous enemy resistance

  • Weapons and equipment to unlock, purchase, and equip between missions

  • Enemy vehicles, turrets, aircraft, ships, and other battlefield threats

  • Multiple combat operations with distinct environments and objectives

  • Stylized modern-retro visuals with top-down / isometric-inspired action

  • Keyboard/mouse and gamepad support

You're a support agent at DrumWorks (any resemblance to existing platforms is

purely coincidental) with exactly one job: approve or deny refund requests for

video games. Read the complaint, check it against the policy, click APPROVE or

DENY — and pray you hit quota before your manager notices you haven't.

The apartment

After hours you crawl back to the dump grandma left you (rest her soul). Manage

a deeply sophisticated needs system: bowel, shower, kebab intake. Pay the water

Made for Myself

An indie game developed by a solo developer.

Back when I was young, after finishing my first "Infinite Genre" novel, I scoured the internet looking for games and other works in the same style. Unfortunately, few creators were making such games at the time, so the idea eventually fizzled out.

I chose a career in game development partly to finally realize that old dream. As the saying goes, "The things we couldn't have in our youth will haunt us for a lifetime."

So, in a way, this game is a gift to the version of myself from fourteen years ago.

What Is the "Infinite Genre"?

When you feel bored, helpless, or hopeless with your life, you are chosen by the "Main God."

From that moment on, you no longer belong to your original world. The Main God sends you into one world after another.

Upon completing a world, you return to the Main God's hub space with reward points. Here, you can exchange points for anything you desire: items, equipment, bloodlines, or combat styles. You can even directly purchase attributes like muscle mass, reflexes, physique, and energy—with no upper limit.

Once the exchange is complete, you move on to the next world.

Reincarnate with Friends

Supports online co-op for 1 to 8 players; join the same session via Steam friend invites or public lobbies.

The team votes on which path to take; team events require a group vote, while individual events are decided by each player.

Teammates who fall in battle will revive with 1 HP once the fight ends. No one dies outside of combat.

Turn-Based Combat

Spend your action points to attack, defend, reposition, or use your abilities and inventory items.

Your weapon dictates your combat style: blades can only strike the front row, while pistols can hit the back row—though every shot consumes ammunition.

Wisely managing your HP, items, and abilities is the key to victory.

Who Do You Want to Be?

Start by defining who you are: your background, the reason the Main God chose you, and your past experiences.

Those raised in orphanages have faster reflexes, while the wealthy enter the game with medical supplies and provisions; firefighters, doctors, programmers, and esports players all begin with different starting advantages. Shape Yourself Through Exchanges:

Bloodlines (equip up to two simultaneously): Vampire, Taoist, Orthodox Qigong Master, Elven Archer, Ninja, Card Summoner, Necromancer, Demon Hunter, Cat-girl, Githyanki... Each bloodline evolves from Rank D to Rank S, with stats and unique abilities growing along the way.

Styles (choose only one): Iaijutsu, Spellcaster, Gunslinger, Contractor, Investigator, Psionicist, Combat Medic. Your style dictates your combat tactics.

Gear and Items: Over a hundred pieces of equipment and nearly a hundred types of items. Four equipment slots (Weapon, Head, Torso, Boots) and an eight-slot inventory.

Not every item is designed to be equally powerful. Some are niche or eccentric, existing solely to enable a specific build. Combining these odd choices is exactly where the fun lies.

If the dizzying array of abilities and gear leaves you feeling overwhelmed, ask yourself: what kind of character do *you* want to become?

Multiple Worlds, Distinct Rulesets

Each world features its own story, enemies, and events, along with a unique battlefield rule that can completely alter the flow of combat.

On a cold summer day, the Old Man turns to you for help. He asks you to buy a trinket, but only wants one ruble for it. You wonder, "How can one ruble help someone?" However, you soon learn that the item you received is not useless; the help provided is not at all about money.

 Characters

Despite the fact that the events take place in Verkhnedarsk rather than on Olympus, a goddess ended up in Felix’s (our protagonist) study group.

Top-tier waifu (12/10), the character of the millennium. Stylish, sharp-witted, and fun. What more could you possibly need? Order your Eva dakimakura using the link in the description!

Contrary to the first thought that may have crossed your mind, this young lady has no connection whatsoever to the Church. She earned her proud title of “sister” purely by virtue of her blood relation to the protagonist.

Agile and virtuous enough not to get stuck in washing machines. Isn’t she just adorable?

Felix’s classmate and, incidentally, his friend. He’s quite good at chess - something he makes sure to remind everyone of on a regular basis, much to their overwhelming delight (or so he believes).

Another classmate. Can he be called a friend? Hardly. He’ll ditch you at the first opportunity - convenient or not. Some might even find Igor amusing. Felix certainly does (probably).

It’s obvious that you’re curious about the meaning of the word “cryptophraseologist.” Perhaps some of you even went looking for it in Dahl’s or Ozhegov’s dictionary - and found nothing. That’s because this elaborate word was specially coined by a team of philologists - British scientists, no less - just for our visual novel. Yes, we can afford that.

The protagonist’s friend. She had to sacrifice a pompous title in order to obtain a surname.

An unprepared reader might get the impression that she likes Felix. In fact, that’s exactly how things stand.

Jokes aside - this is the Mysterious Old Man. He asks you for help, and you (as any sensible person would) agree.

Planned Features*:

  • A non-linear, unpredictable plot with conclusive endings: from relatively positive to perilously hopeless.

  • A cocktail of genres. Hop on an emotional roller coaster where horror scenes alternate with comedy and vice versa.

  • Six love interests. 2D goddesses with quirks to suit every taste are just waiting for you to catch their attention. No hentai included - this is a serious comedy horror, not that sort of thing!

  • The dialogue was crafted by a specially trained team of philologists. And while you're wondering where an indie studio gets the money for a whole team, I'll tell you that the voices in your head don't need a salary.

  • The protagonist can die at any moment: from laughter, fear, cringe, carelessness, anthrax, an enraged bear, otherworldly interference, or a helicopter crash.

  • Difficult choices. Decisions won't always be simple and obvious, and their consequences may become apparent later, increasing the uncertainty of the external environment. However, some choices have no impact whatsoever.

  • Living characters. Each of them has their own problems. You can help them, or you can make things worse. The choice is yours.

* We’re planning 6 chapters, to be released as they’re completed. The features listed apply to the final version of the game.

Every Level is a New World Unlike traditional rhythm games, every stage in Rhythm Roll is a fresh visual and audio experience. One moment you are rolling through a 1980s retro neon city, and the next, you are dodging obstacles in a minimalist geometric space or navigating a dark cyberpunk future. Each stage features a distinct visual aesthetic and a unique genre of music—from high-energy Synthwave and Electro to relaxing Lo-fi and intense Drum & Bass.

Key Features:

  • Fast-Paced Rhythm Gameplay: Simple one-touch or directional controls that anyone can pick up, but hard to master.

  • Diverse Visual Aesthetics: No two levels look or feel the same. Experience a wide variety of neon colors, geometry dash styles, and futuristic themes.

  • Unique Electronic Soundtracks: Every level is custom-built around a specific music track, making the rhythm an essential part of the gameplay challenge.

  • Increasing Difficulty & Speed: The game starts with a smooth cruise but quickly evolves into a hardcore test of your focus, timing, and reaction speed.

Can you keep up with the music, master the tempo, and conquer every level? Get ready to feel the beat and test your skills in Rhythm Roll!

Rich PaPa

You literally shoot money.

Rich PaPa is a third-person action shooter where every shot costs you cash because money itself is your ammunition.

Blast through hordes of zombies, bounce shots off the environment with ricochets, and decide how much money you are willing to fire away to survive.

Your money is both your weapon and your lifeline. Spend too much in combat and you may survive the battle only to find yourself heading toward bankruptcy.

SPEND MONEY TO FIGHT

Every shot has a price.

Pulling the trigger means firing your own money, forcing you to constantly balance firepower against the cash you have left.

MASTER RICOCHET SHOTS

Use walls and the environment to bounce your shots into enemies.

A well-placed ricochet can turn a difficult encounter into an efficient kill and help you save precious money.

SPIN THE ROULETTE

Take a chance on roulette-based upgrades that can change the course of each stage.

Powerful effects can give you an edge, but every decision is part of the risk and reward of pushing forward.

SURVIVE THE ZOMBIE HORDES

Fight your way through stage-based battles filled with zombies and escalating threats.

Manage your attacks, upgrades, and remaining cash as you try to make it to the end without going broke.

HOW MUCH ARE YOU WILLING TO SPEND TO SURVIVE?

In Rich PaPa, survival is not free.

A one-button ricochet score-attack shooter

You don't aim freely. The reticle swings left and right on its own, and only one bolt can be in play. You choose when to fire. Learning to work with that limitation — and turning one shot into a long ricochet — is the heart of the game.

Three rules

  • Left click (or Space) to fire
  • Press again to clear the bolt
  • If a single enemy reaches the line at the bottom, the run is over
That is everything you need to know. The rest you pick up by shooting.

Every shot is a small ricochet puzzle

Your bolt ricochets off the walls and keeps flying until it burns out. Some monsters knock it back as well, so every shot carves a different path through the swarm. Bad angle? Clear it and fire again. You are only ever planning one bolt at a time.

The longer a shot lives, the more it pays

Every monster a single bolt kills feeds a running total that keeps building until that bolt is gone. The second kill pays more than the first, the third more than the second — one well-placed shot can swing an entire run. How you make it bounce is for you to find out.

Two modes, two difficulties

  • Normal — a run takes about five to seven minutes. Survive the swarm, and a boss is waiting at the end.
  • Endless — no finish line. The monsters are the same ones you meet in Normal, but each lap makes them more dangerous. See how far you can push your LEVEL, and pick up again from a level you have already reached.
Difficulty comes in Standard and Nightmare. Nightmare does not bring in new kinds of monsters, but more of them show up, and some of them move far more aggressively. Under a moonlit sky, it asks you to fight through denser waves than Standard, and it unlocks as you progress through Endless.

Compete

  • Online leaderboards — four boards, one for each combination of mode and difficulty
  • 19 achievements

Start with the free demo

The swinging aim is deliberately different from free aiming. Try the free demo to see whether its rhythm clicks with you — the entire Normal mode is included, at exactly the same balance as the full game, with no time limit and as many runs as you like.
  • Demo scores do not carry over to the full game or to the online leaderboards
  • The full game adds: Endless, online leaderboards, 19 achievements, and Nightmare difficulty

What this game is

A game built around short runs you replay to get more out of a single shot. Under one simple set of rules, you keep noticing that the last shot could have gone further — and the way you read the next one changes. A run takes about five to seven minutes, and it ends just early enough to make you want one more.

Because you never know who you’re going to pick up next…

RIDICULOUS SPACE BATTLES is the spiritual successor to the first ever autobattler game: Gratuitous Space Battles! After a fifteen year wait, the ridiculously over-the-top and completely unjustified battles in space ARE BACK.

A completely new game, developed from scratch but inspired by the original, Ridiculous Space Battles hopes to truly live up to its name. Enjoy putting together increasingly huge wastes of galactic taxpayers money to build truly huge fleets of awesome space battleships to fight (for reasons unspecified) over vague patches of empty space against a range of despicable aliens who are (for reasons unspecified) our sworn enemies!

There are a number of significant differences between Ridiculous Space Battles and its now ancient predecessor. Firstly the player now places ships onto a fixed grid. No more fiddling with the mouse trying to get neat formations! And ships are placed now in fixed sized squadrons. 1 Cruiser (huge!) or 4 Frigates (big!) or 25 fighters (tiny).

However RSB still has orders! Oh yes. There are a number of orders that determine how close to move the formation to the enemy, which ships to target, and under what circumstances ship should open fire. Utilize cunning formation and order combinations to take down enemy shields, then armor, then destroy the hull!

Final victory is declared when all the ships on one fleet are destroyed or have escaped. The fleet with the largest total value of escaped or surviving ships is the victor!

RSB is a game about spectacle and insanely large space battles. We will not bore you with 100 tutorial levels explaining how to pit a single fighter against a single fighter. If you have come here wanting to blow up billions of tons of alien warships ASAP you are in the right place.

There are a bunch of new weapons and effects for your warships that you will not have seen in the original GSB game. The main criteria was to make them look extremely awesome. Nothing less than awesomeness was acceptable in our game design! We added new twirly wavey beams that crackle with particles and wave around all over the place. Why? Because they look awesome!

Every explosion in our game is a source of pride. Say goodbye to lame short puffs of flame when a ship explodes, and say hello to ridiculous particle effects, shockwave, plumes and so many lens flares I'm surprised JJ Abrams has not sued us yet. Not only may our game contain flashing lights, its got more flashing lights that an explosion in an LED factory.

We decided that fleets of big cruisers was not complex enough, so we added 4x as many frigates, and then 25x as many fighters, and then we still wanted to ramp up the complex ballet of laser beamage to ever more stupid amounts, so say hello to the 'beam-laser-equipped drone swarm launcher podule'. Be warned, your video card will probably need therapy after you use these.

A single-player campaign mode and online challenge modes are planned for release during Early Access.

A grimdark tactical roguelike. Pick a hero, draft an army, raid a rift, and decide at every node whether to go home rich or go one deeper. Runs are short.

Command your army on the grid

Your units fight as stacks: one tile, one unit type, as many bodies as you brought. Each turn you move a stack, attack, or cast a spell, and the enemy answers in turn order.

One hero per faction, and one for none

Choose a hero, draft your keepsake, starting units and first spell, and ride out with a signature relic. Every relic you buy or find after that makes the hero stronger, and the rare ones bring an effect of their own.

Spells that play by their faction's rules

Fire burns and cashes the burn in, Water swings the turn order, Forest roots and regrows, Light mends the wounded and punishes the many, Dark pays in blood. Pick one at the gate, buy the rest in the rift.

Every node is a choice

The rift is a branching map. Fights, elites, a boss, shops, story events with real consequences, laid across biomes from snowfield to swamp to crystal cave. You pick the path, and each node you pass is one you cannot come back to.

Get it out, or lose it

Resources are yours once you extract or beat the boss. Fall first and you lose what you carried. What you banked before stays banked.

Rebuild the kingdom

Spend what you brought home on buildings that change the next run. One path per faction, neutral buildings for every army, and the Runic Anchor above them all.

Try the free demo!

In a fantasy battlefield beyond this world, you will build your own card army and forge your defense line with the power of cards.

[RiftBlade: WarCards] combines the strategic depth of classic card battles with the escalating pressure of tower defense, while introducing tactical grid movement and unique unit mechanics. Enemies will continuously emerge from portals on the right side of the battlefield, advancing toward your base crystal on the left.

As the commander, you must draw cards, manage your action points, summon powerful heroes, deploy units, and unleash magic and traps to create a dynamic battlefield defense. Use your strategy to defeat every invader and protect your crystal at all costs.

* * *

**Key Features**

### **Deckbuilding Meets Dynamic Defense**

Build your deck with three different card types: **Character Cards, Magic Cards, and Arcane Cards**.Each turn, spend your limited Action Points to summon units, move characters, and activate powerful effects. Character Cards can move across the battlefield like tactical units, blocking enemies and launching attacks.

### **Enemy Waves & Crystal Defense**

Enemies emerge from portals on the right side of the battlefield and gradually advance toward your base.Your crystal’s HP determines victory or defeat — protect it from destruction and eliminate every enemy to claim victory.

### **Unique Units & Tactical Positioning**

Every Character Card belongs to a specific class, with unique movement rules, attack ranges, and battlefield roles.Powerful units require more energy to deploy, and every stage limits your available energy. Choose your forces wisely and make every move count.

### **• Deck Building & Card Weight System**

Character Cards can be destroyed during battle, making resource management and timely retreats essential.If a powerful card is lost, it can be purchased again from the shop. Analyze enemy types and stage conditions, then build the perfect deck to create the strongest defense with limited resources.

### **• Turn-Based Tactical Card Combat**

Experience a strategic turn-based system inspired by TCG gameplay:**Draw Cards → Summon / Activate Effects → Move → Attack**

Both allies and enemies exist as cards on the battlefield, creating a unique blend of immediate defensive pressure and deep strategic decision-making.

* * *

Every card drawn, every summon made, and every spell cast can change the fate of the battlefield.

Create your ultimate deck, stand between the portals and the crystal, and carve your own legend with the blade of another world.

**Are you ready?**Face the endless enemies pouring from the portals.Raise your blade in this forgotten realm, and as the commander, decide the fate of the battle.

Features

  • Hand-crafted Levels

  • Recruit New Heroes

  • Unlock New Abilities

  • Equip stronger items

  • Conquer tricky challenges

Story

Liora, a young girl who loves to experiment with forces of nature, is in a predicament.

After her latest feat of pouring and mixing a few things here and there - a big flash of dark light, and a great rift has opened. A vast shadow is poured onto the lands of near and far. Dark morphlings come out of portals, imprisoning land's inhabitants in the shadow realm, and taking their forms.

"WHAT HAVE I DONE?!" - gasped Liora.

"It is all my fault."

... or so she thought.

The weight of single-handedly dooming the world has dropped off her shoulders, when the evil responsible took stage:

"The great Dark Riftweaver has come to your world." - announced one Dark General

"Let the darkness soothe you. Obey!" - sizzled another.

It is now up to Liora to use her wits and with help of friends to become the heroes the land needs.

See through Liora's adventure and help our friends vanquish the Dark Riftweaver.

Onward! Time is of the essence.

Build the farm. Grow the business. Make a life worth working for.

Riggin Farm: Raw Land to Riches is a single-player farming and business management RPG inspired by a real working farm and its owners, Nick & Ashley Riggin. Guide Nick and Ashley as they turn 25 acres of undeveloped woodland into a diversified agricultural business over a campaign spanning up to twenty years.

Start with raw land, limited resources, and a shared ambition. Clear space for your home, establish your first growing beds, and decide which enterprises deserve your time and money. Watch the property take shape as gardens, orchards, pastures, high tunnels, and working buildings become part of everyday farm life.

Every expansion changes the job. More crops need more harvesting. More animals need more feed. A bigger market display needs enough products to fill it and someone with enough energy left to sell them.

  • Two farmers, different strengths. Control Nick, Ashley, or both together. Divide the workload or team up on suitable jobs, making use of Nick’s strength in physical work and Ashley’s precision. Develop their abilities across six skill disciplines and choose perks that support the farm you want to build.

  • Grow the soil alongside the crops. Start seedlings under grow lights, transplant into prepared beds, and manage vegetables, orchard crops, and protected growing spaces. Soil fertility, crop rotation, cover crops, compost, weeds, and water all influence production. Harvest whole crops or return for successive pickings as plants visibly change through their growing cycles.

  • Raise animals that need real care. Build enterprises around chickens, pigs, and cattle. Manage feed, breeding, housing, fencing, and routine health inspections. Maintain the infrastructure that keeps animals safe, and round up escapees when a damaged fence turns an ordinary workday into an unexpected chase.

  • Turn the harvest into a product. Wash and bag salad, harvest and pack microgreens, cook preserves, and develop other value-added foods. Equip your Wash Pack building as the business grows. Ingredients, packaging, labor, refrigeration, freezer space, and dry storage all matter when deciding what to make and how much you can handle.

  • Get hands-on when you want to. Play optional mini-games for a chance at bonus XP, or watch the assigned farmer complete the task automatically. Collect eggs, milk cows, unload feed, mow pasture, prepare products, and tackle the market rush. The work still uses farm time and resources whichever approach you choose.

  • Build a business around what people buy. Prepare your farmers-market booth, organize displays and back stock, set prices, and respond to customer demand. Expand into farm-store sales and commercial accounts with restaurants and other buyers. Balance fresh inventory, delivery commitments, operating costs, and debt; a bumper harvest only helps if you can store it and sell it.

  • Give customers a reason to follow your farm. Take actual in-game photos, crop them, and choose a caption about farm life, growing practices, or upcoming products. Watch the feed fill with likes and comments. Marketing can build demand, but advertising products you leave behind (or selling out before the early rush is over) can damage your reputation.

  • Plan around weather, energy, and each other. Seasonal daylight and changing weather shape the working day. Heat, hard labor, fatigue, and lingering soreness affect what Nick and Ashley can accomplish. Make room for morning coffee, recovery, and time together while managing the pressure that a growing farm places on their morale and relationship.

  • Grow into the owner’s role. Build infrastructure yourself or hire contractors, maintain equipment, recruit employees, and eventually develop a manager who can take on more responsibility. Decide what to delegate and where your own time matters most. Work toward a farm that can support its owners and give them room to enjoy the life they have built.

Plans will change. Storms roll in, equipment fails, employees call out, and repairs compete with harvests for the same afternoon. Sometimes the interruption is a serious business problem. Sometimes the barn cats have simply decided that your empty crates belong to them now.

A playable demo will be released in October 2026. This two-day slice takes you to an established farm in Year 6, where you’ll guide Nick and Ashley through Friday’s farm work and product preparation before heading to the Farmers Market on Saturday.

Inspired by the satisfaction, strain, and occasional absurdity of running a real diversified farm, Riggin Farm: Raw Land to Riches asks you to build something that lasts. Wishlist the game and find out whether you can run Riggin Farm better than its real-life owners.

So you heat your rivals up, then launch them clean off the arena to take them out. Last one standing wins.

Ring them out

It's 2146. Yiling, a girl from New Shanghai, has just moved into her dorm at the Jiutian Institute of Interstellar Navigation.

She's about to learn how to cross the vast distances between the stars. For now, though, she has more pressing things to figure out: keeping up with classes, making new friends, and deciding what time to go to bed tonight.

You'll be her companion through afternoons made for daydreaming and nights that call for a little more effort. Listen to her stories of campus life in the future, remember the names she often mentions, and begin to discover her world from one small dorm room.

Interstellar travel takes careful planning. Spending time with her doesn't.

Bring whatever you'd like to do today. Or simply stay a while.

An Endless Cycle of Rotation

Every planet has its own days and nights.

Like you, Yiling has plans of her own. Sometimes she studies, sometimes she rests, and sometimes she'd rather leave unfinished things until tomorrow. You can join her rhythm or each keep your own. As the days pass, new stories and little changes gradually find their way into this small dorm room.

Experience accumulates while the game is running. Every focus session, yours or hers, contributes to her growth, gradually unlocking new story scenes and room decorations. There's no need for constant interaction. Spend time with her at your own pace, and let companionship become part of your everyday life.

Traces Through Spacetime, Never Forgotten

Time spent with care, and ideas that arrive in a flash, deserve to be remembered.

Break distant goals into little things you can do today. Give your habits a little time, and your ideas somewhere to land. You and Yiling can make plans and find your way forward, one day at a time.

The Pomodoro timer, planning panel, and idea notes help you make time to focus and put your thoughts in order. Use Pomodoro sessions to make progress on goals, to-dos, and habits, or mark them complete yourself. The calendar keeps a history of your progress and ideas, with the option to export your records. Your efforts deserve to be preserved.

The Universe's Gently Shifting Frequencies

Sometimes, a little sound makes the world feel quieter.

Fill the background with rain among the high-rises at night, or the sounds of a summer classroom. Add a melody in no particular hurry. Whether you're focusing on something or simply daydreaming with Yiling, there's a sound to keep you company as the time goes by.

Find your rhythm with Lofi music and ambient themes spanning synthetic sounds, nature, and everyday life. From synthetic noise in its many colors to streams, coastlines, and a winter hearth, each theme offers sounds you can mix and adjust, with subtle variations that keep unfolding. You're changing more than the volume: a breeze might pass now and then, or return in gust after gust. Let the world around you sound just the way you like it.

Distant Starlight, Drawing Closer

The shape of an era can be found in one person's everyday life.

Worries about class, funny stories between friends, a name mentioned in passing: each offers a glimpse of 2146. You'll meet new people alongside Yiling and gradually discover the wider world beyond her dorm. Those casual conversations also hold clues to another question: who, exactly, are you in her world?

The story moves forward as Yiling grows, with further updates to come after launch. Full Chinese voice acting, precise lip sync, and nuanced facial animation bring her words and emotions to life, letting you hear the smile in her voice and see the hesitation she leaves unspoken.

An Ideal Space, All Your Own

One dorm room can hold so many different moods.

Let the light of a clear afternoon linger, or bring a rainy night to the window. Pick an outfit for Yiling, add a few new decorations, and shape everyday life into something you love, little by little.

Choose the time of day and weather ambience, spend the points you've earned on room decorations, and dress Yiling in different outfits. You can also try particle effects created from randomly generated formulas, adjust them yourself, and copy and share them, adding a little unexpected delight to decorating her room.

The mist has covered the village for as long as anyone can remember. It hides the sky, and no one alive has seen what lies beyond it.

Only the Spire rises through it. The legend says whoever reaches the top learns the way out. The legend also says something inside is waiting to make certain no one does.

RISE FROM ASHES combines survivors-like action with auto-chess strategy. Assemble a deck of Scrolls, activate powerful Synergies, and fight through hordes with skills that fire automatically. Between battles, upgrade and rearrange the deck to try new combinations or push a favorite build further.

BUILD AROUND POWERFUL SYNERGIES

Every Scroll contributes to Synergies that unlock as more matching Scrolls are equipped.

  • Main Synergies define a playstyle. Fight at low Life for greater power, spread poison through enemy ranks, or unleash attacks with every dash.

  • Sub Synergies refine the build with faster projectiles, repeated casts and additional summons.

Different activation thresholds and limited slots make each combination a trade-off. Commit to a few key Synergies or combine several for a broader set of effects. The deck can be freely adjusted before every battle.

MAKE EACH SCROLL PART OF THE BUILD

Spend Embers to buy Scrolls and reroll the shop, then develop the skills that bring the build together.

  • Merge Scrolls to raise their Star Grade, strengthen their skills and unlock more Sigil slots.

  • Bind Sigils to boost stats or add new effects. Combine Normal Sigils into Special Sigils for unique abilities and new ways to use familiar Scrolls.

The same Scroll can serve different roles depending on its Sigils and the Synergies around it.

PREPARE FOR THE NEXT CHALLENGE

Return to the Village to invest in permanent upgrades and explore new build options.

  • Memories: Permanently strengthen the Challenger's abilities.

  • Synergy Deck: Choose the Synergies to build around before entering the Spire.

  • Testaments: Collect modifiers during Challenges and equip them in the Village to change how Main Synergies work.

EVERY RUN IS A VOLUME OF COMIC BOOK.

The world is drawn entirely in black and white, in ink and hatching, like the pages of a comic. We wanted you to feel like you opened a book since every run you take in the Spire will tell a different story.

ALSO IN THE SPIRE

  • The Wheel of Fate. Spin a single wheel to discover your next stage. Its segments change as you climb, shifting the balance of battles, events, rest and treasure.

  • Arcadia. Something that cannot be killed is eating into the Wheel and your potential. Avoid and stop it to overcome your fates.

  • Battlefield Objects. Battlefield objects offer powerful one-time effects at a cost. The Ravenous Furnace can cover the ground in fire, burning through Embers to fuel it.

  • Events. Events use token tosses to determine outcomes, with character stats and Ember spending improving the odds.

Prepare, Plan and Build your way to the Top.

Rise of the Merchants is a medieval simulation game - combining city-building, economics, politics, and trade, set in a persistent online world. Start with a small settlement in your county, develop it into an influential city, and establish a trade network that extends far beyond its borders. Produce sought-after goods, dispatch trade caravans, build production facilities, and trade with NPCs and other players.

Yet there is no single path to success: overcome challenges through economic acumen, political influence, clever planning, or cunning strategy and live with the consequences of your decisions.

Develop your settlement into a mighty trading city:

Construct over 50 different buildings and production facilities for your growing population. Upgrade your structures into impressive urban landmarks and expand your economic influence across the entire game world. Choose from various building materials, colors, and upgrade levels to give your settlement a unique character. The user interface ensures a quick start with few clicks and a clear overview. New systems are introduced gradually, allowing "Rise of the Merchants" to start off accessible while unfolding increasing economic, political, and social depth as your city grows.

Produce, plan, and trade:

Build complex production chains, process raw materials into high-quality goods, and meet the growing needs of your population. Dispatch trade caravans to neighboring settlements and trade with both NPCs and other players. Factor in distances, terrain, and the threat of bandit raids to keep your trade routes safe and profitable. NPC traders ensure reliable markets even when player activity fluctuates, while the dynamic player-driven economy opens up new opportunities for specialization, cooperation, and competition.

Make your settlers the heart of your strategy:

Each settler brings unique skills, traits, and needs that influence your city's production, trade, security, and social life. Strategically utilize their talents, foster their development, and get to know their strengths, concerns, and personal stories to unlock their full potential. Unexpected stories can emerge from your decisions: a settler you help today might later provide the decisive advantage thanks to a special skill. However, illness, conflict, or poor choices can just as quickly put valuable workers at risk. Outcomes aren't scripted—they emerge from the interplay between your settlers, your decisions, and the living world around you.

Choose your path to wealth and influence:

The game's chapters present specific tasks but do not dictate how you should solve them. Leverage economic strength, political connections, skillful negotiation, or intrigue to achieve your goals. Win the favor of the nobility, assume key roles in the civic and city councils, and use your political influence to unlock new possibilities. Alternatively, resort to sabotage and other cunning tactics in optional PvP to hinder your rivals. Carefully weighed risks and matchmaking systems let you decide just how much you are willing to put on the line.

Write your story in a world that never stands still:

Build and develop your city independently, while trade, competition, and the decisions made by you and your fellow players shape the persistent online world. Regularly changing seasons present you with exciting new challenges.

The world of Rivendale is open for exploration: grow ingredients on your farm, gather resources in nature, or trade with local vendors.

River Runners is a single player auto-scroller adventure game developed for PC. The player plays against the rapid currents of the river while controlling a log and a merry band of animals, attempting to avoid the various obstacles that appear along the way.

Furthermore, the game has both a narrative story driven mode where the player meets the different characters and is introduced to their abilities, as well as the meaning of their journey, and an endless mode that starts the player off with all abilities unlocked, and increases in difficulty over time, randomly generating modules that bring a sense of randomness to each session the player goes through.

Features:

  • Multiple Levels

  • Endless Game Mode

  • Meet a small cast of charming animal characters

  • Experience the banter between the crew

  • You can poke a beaver.

Company bankrupt. Out of money. Out of options.

One day, a mysterious man suddenly appears before you.

What he hands you is an invitation to a deadly game where an enormous fortune awaits the winner.

To survive, you must overcome a series of suspicious games.

A card game where the higher submitted card wins.

A rock-paper-scissors game where your cards gradually run out.

A board game where placing three stones in a row means defeat.

…and many more.

At first glance, the rules seem simple.

Yet none of the games reveal an obvious path to victory.

But there is always a way.

Analyze the rules, uncover the hidden winning strategies, and survive to claim the fortune!

A shocking twist may be waiting for you at the very end…

  • A puzzle game focused on analyzing game rules, discovering hidden strategies, and finding the path to victory.

This ain't no ordinary Earth-based road house!  

This one hops the universe, and is powered by beer... or to be more accurate: hyper-beer!

Get ready for a journey through alternate dimensions of roadhouse. Find love, secrets, an arch nemesis, snarky robots and stinky aliens, and serve enough hyper-beers to collapse all of 2D reality! 

It will take many, many hyper-beers to end the universe!!! 

In three different queues at a time!

Welcome to The Fog’s End: a roadhouse at an intersection of virtual dimensions where there are many thirsty travelers.

Some customers will be nice. Feed them beer and cocktails the universe's highest shelf of quality.

Some customers will be trouble-makers, jerks, or losers from the fake roadhouse dimension. Those customers, you gotta beat up.

VIPs are vital for your roadhouse. These VIPs are lost in the fog of this interdimensional roadhouse space. Lost until they see your OPEN sign light up.  

You'll need to impress them with a bunch of flair tricks and then craft a top-shelf cocktail in a poker-inspired pours with MULT combos. Can you impress the connoisseurs with your zany concoctions?? 
Combine your collected top-shelf booze to craft a 'drink-poker' of exceptional quality to please the VIPs! 

Some of the worst customers are super-drunk aliens that phase in and out of reality portals.

If these aliens can break your shielding, they'll basically wreck your roadhouse, causing you ton of costs in damages.

Use your smarts to keep these dastardly drunk aliens contained!

But not all drunk aliens are bad -- collect enough tips to hire a super-drunk alien dancer, who'll please everyone with her outrageous extra-dimensional dance routine. 

No one ever bartended like this before, in gaming.

Each drink is a performance in The Fog’s End. You’ll need some good flair to impress your VIPs. Toss the glass, spin it, and do all sorts of tricks. So impressive!!!!!!!


As the days go on, you’ll need an increasingly a better roadhouse to entice fog-wanderers to stop by. Spend mojo and money upgrading your roadhouse: show lights, plants, seating, appliances, a games room, O2 bar, karaoke, and 70 more upgrades. The day time is for casual prepping, and the night time: pure chaos! 

Keep customers happy and you'll be rewarded new blueprint cards. Collect and build enough matching upgrades in a set will unlock powerful new amenities that'll impress even the most picky and famous VIP guests, and provide you with a Booster ability to help your survive it all!

You have a magic interdimensional jukebox that can bring in over 150 songs from alternate dimensions, and multiversal cable TV, to enjoy in your roadhouse! 

To keep hoping through interdimensions though, you need an engine -- and that's where your B.A.R comes in!  Through some super advanced neutrino quark anti-matter pulsons chronotriggers the B.A.R uses fusion-cooled beer to keep cool, and power the hyper-engines allowing you to hop dimensionally.  This game is deep like that! 

But watch out -- a couple of hyper-beers too short and you may have a disaster on your hands!

If push comes to shove, you’ll have to deliver an occasional beat-down to keep the unruly guests chilled and reasonable. Punch, kick, and throw unruly guests down the stairs to prevent a giant bar fight from breaking out, wrecking your roadhouse! 

Or, for a softer approach, collect tips to hire an alien dancer!

Many Unique Trouble-Making Thugs & An Arch-Nemesis! 

The hard-ass robot bastard upstairs wants you to fail. He watches you closely, and depending on your success, will react by hiring henchmen. 

Boxers. Keg-tossers. Drug addicts. Seductresses. Many unique types of trouble in this roadhouse! Even Xenu-calling scientologists will be sent for you to deal with, each with their own weaknesses, strengths, special abilities.  They'll get promoted or demoted depending on how they fare against you, and if you're unlucky enough, one will become your Arch-Nemesis!
